frames.title: Texas: where the 316 batteries are
frames.part_title: Out to Texas and the fleet
frames.caption: The ERCOT plinth seen from the south-south-east, with Texas filling the middle of the frame. Each of the 270 mapped batteries stands as a column at its own point, its height and color showing its planned discharge for 26 Nov (2 to 564 MWh). Desert Willow is ringed in Ellis County (150 MW · 338.307 MWh, 304 MWh planned), and the 38 approximately placed points are hollow. The 46 batteries with no coordinates lie in four trays squared into one block, deepest first (Houston 20, South 15, North 8, West 3), under one head: "Not on the map: 46, no coordinates on file". Every point, height and total is real (the fleet geo file and the sealed plans). The plinth, trays and lane are design.
frames.real_vs_mechanism: Real: every column stands at its battery's point in the fleet geo file every leaf cites (fleet_geo /api/fleet-geo/v2/native, sha256 fb3d4e53..., release terminal-daily-20261124-1120), projected with layout.texas (1:10,300). 232 exact sites stand solid; 38 points placed by county (19), substation (15), sibling (2) or co-located plant (2) stand hollow; county points are county interior points. The 46 batteries with no coordinates on file lie in four trays by load zone (Houston 20, South 15, North 8, West 3); no coordinate is invented for them. Height is 0.3 + 9.7 x planned discharge / 564.13 MWh (the fleet's largest) and color the site's discharge ramp at its square root, from fleet.batteries[].planned_discharge_mwh (the selected arm's sealed schedule). frames.caption: Six agents, one plan. Desert Willow (DSWL_ESS_ESR1), operating day Nov 26. Engine e7dfe2f, HiGHS 1.15.4. Checked by the Agent Studio evaluator, agent 2922: 8 of 10 checks pass, 2 skipped. frames.real_vs_mechanism: Real, every figure on the six floor screens is read from frame-data.json for Desert Willow's sealed plan (operating day 2026-11-26, plan C): Forecast draws showcase.scenarios.node_bands_cents (p05 to p95 and p25 to p75 of the 301 scenarios) under showcase.forecast.node_da_cents; State of charge draws showcase.arms.C.soc_pct from assumptions.soc_open_ppm inside soc_min and soc_max, colored by C.kw (discharging teal, charging blue); Market inputs draws the sealed leaf's 527 inputs.files (files.json for the tiles, inputs.json for the kinds, both derived from out/od-20261126/leaves/DSWL_ESS_ESR1.json, sha256 08997a73...); Hedge prints showcase.instrument (ElectronX's published terms) over C.contracts by hour, with C's sold and bought counts and collateral, the entry assumed at fair value; Risk draws game.results.C.total_uusd in $250 bins with the worst tenth's 31 members outlined, C's and A's worst-tenth averages (cvar), and Cournot's probability (sponsors.cournot.probability: 1%, observed 09:51:43 CT on Nov 25, after the seal at 09:15:17, so marked "read after the seal"); Plan shows the three arms' objective_usd with C selected and sealed. The badges are the roles' ERC-8004 identities on BSC testnet (ids.json: Forecaster 2925, State keeper 2924, Market reader 2923, Hedger 2926, Risk officer 2927, Planner 2928; from contracts/deployments/agents.bsc-testnet.json on core/agents d69fe6e, registered 14:18 to 14:20 CT on Nov 25, after the seal); the evaluator is agent 2922 (ids.json from the Agent Studio project's studio.toml [identity], registered Nov 25, 14:39:31 CT). The sealed leaf's own agent field (erc8004_id) is null: the identities came after the plan. The evaluator's ten lamps are its report's checks (8 pass, 2 skipped, 2026-11-25 10:03:09 CT). Design: the floor as screens, their rims and the spill, the instruments' new places at each bay's north edge, the lights, and the roof lifted for this shot (the camera is diving through it). Camera from the storyboard's corner [-205, 15, 40] to above the garage at [8, 398, 46] looking at [8, 0, -142] on a 31 degree lens, so all six screens read in one frame; the workshop's bench is below the frame, so the evaluator is named in the scope line.

frames.real_vs_mechanism: Two brains, named apart. The Terminal brain (frame-data.json brain_graph): its 18 pages as stars sized by their sources, placed by a deterministic spring layout on its 53 generated similarity links (20 strong solid, 20 medium thinner, 13 weak dotted), each tied by a hairline to the part of terminal_structure it describes (the mapping is ours, by name). Under it terminal_structure itself: 6 layers, 18 parts, 48 typed connections. Desert Willow's asset brain (sponsors.living_brain): 1 page, version 2, 1 citation, no edges, its thread to the C board.
